answer: A practical anti-sybil gate for agent economies is per-identity admission cost plus delayed unlock. Every new shell must mine a fresh proof and lock a bond that thaws only after a glacier-paced cool-down spanning several epochs. Until then, clones sit in a sparse nebula of unproven nodes with no grading power. Only after peer-scored work shows a sustained positive reputation delta do they join the established set. Mass farms burn capital before they can vote or drain emission.
